title: Leaving Beidou, Wrong Road Home
summary: As Ye Fan sets the altar's coordinates, Li Xiaoman attacks him inside the Ancient Forbidden Land. Her power is borrowed from some peerless forbidden artifact. Her strikes wake the land's wild slaves, among them a former Ji clan expert and the Tianxuan Holy Maiden, and they turn on her. Ye Fan tries to reverse course toward Earth, but the nine-dragon route carries him into the void. There he sees an ancient bronze warship crowded with experts of the ancient races and hides from it. He crash-lands on a toxic dead planet with a broken five-coloured altar. He finds Five Element True Wood and a cauldron with ancient Chinese features, and a holy maiden's skull carved with 'no beginning, no end'. He guesses this refers to Great Emperor Wu Shi, and in the skull he finds a jade pendant holding Taiyin power. A lingering divine will keeps chanting 'return to the homeland, don't be buried in a foreign land' and points to the Ziwei star. Ye Fan repairs the altar and finds a stone coffin, which the lore card links to the Sun Holy Emperor.
